sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Vehicle registration, title, insurance, inspection and efficient driving

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A01
A new resident has sixty days to register a vehicle, while a sale paperwork package after a trade must be mailed within twenty-four hours and a name, address or color change must be reported within thirty days [A01].
Why it matters: group ownership deadlines; difficulty high; prereq sec14-F01; confusables sec14-F01, sec14-F07
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A03
Twenty-five thousand dollars covers one person's death or injury, fifty thousand covers two or more people, and ten thousand covers property damage [A03].
Why it matters: group insurance minimums; difficulty high; prereq sec14-F21; confusables sec14-F22, sec14-F21
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A03
Being uninsured at a stop earns a ticket, fine and two points, whereas being insured but cardless earns fifteen days to produce the card [A03].
Why it matters: group insurance proof; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F23; confusables sec14-F24, sec14-F25
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A02
The purchase and use tax is six percent of the higher of price or fair market value for a purchase, but six percent of acquisition cost minus lease end value for a lease [A02].
Why it matters: group purchase and use tax; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F11; confusables sec14-F11, sec14-F14
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A04
A newly registered vehicle must be inspected within fifteen days, while every vehicle is then inspected once a year as the sticker shows [A04].
Why it matters: group inspection; difficulty low; prereq sec14-F26; confusables sec14-F26, sec14-F10
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A03
A seventeen character identification number is standard since nineteen eighty-one, and verification of it is required only for salvage, bonded title and foreign registered vehicles [A03].
Why it matters: group identification numbers; difficulty medium; prereq sec14-F17; confusables sec14-F17, sec14-F18
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0068]
